scientific_integrity: Exact conditional finite-sample identity and sign classification are analytically proved. Exhaustive graph enumeration through six vertices and selected exact-rational checks through two hundred vertices are corroboration, not evidence for infinite quantifiers. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Simple labeled fixed-edge graphs, \(n\ge6\), degree-two vertices and triangles only; no uniform near-critical signed asymptotics; broad generating-function literature might imply the explicit phase theorem; no independent historical priority determination.
title: Two exact sign reversals in triangle–degree-two covariance of fixed-edge random graphs
